articles.headline: Five Killed in Manipur Ethnic Violence
articles.brief: Fresh ethnic violence in India's Manipur state has left five people dead, exacerbating ongoing regional tensions and prompting urgent calls for increased security measures from local authorities.

articles.headline: OPEC+ Keeps December Oil Targets Steady
articles.brief: OPEC+ has decided to maintain its December oil output targets unchanged, navigating market stability while preparing for more challenging quota negotiations ahead of 2027.

articles.headline: China's BYD Extends Sales Growth Streak
articles.brief: Chinese electric vehicle maker BYD has continued its robust sales expansion driven by strong international export performance, defying broader domestic market cooling trends.

articles.headline: Cyclone Murasu Threatens Southern India
articles.brief: Cyclone Murasu has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm, triggering high alerts across Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh as authorities prepare for heavy rainfall and landfall.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Plummets to Hazardous
articles.brief: Delhi's air quality has deteriorated into the very poor to hazardous categories, prompting the immediate enforcement of strict anti-pollution vehicle curbs and public advisories.

articles.headline: Nine Killed in Florida Plane Crash
articles.brief: A private Learjet crashed into a residential area in Greenacres, Florida, resulting in the deaths of all nine people on board after reporting severe turbulence and icing.

articles.headline: Ebola Fatality Rate Tops 50% in Congo
articles.brief: The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola fatality rate surged above 50% following the inclusion of hundreds of previously unallocated historical deaths into the national health toll.

articles.headline: US Explores Russian Gas Route via Ukraine
articles.brief: The United States is reportedly exploring a proposal to resume Russian natural gas transit through Ukraine to advance broader energy ceasefire and European peace initiatives.

articles.headline: China's Robot Makers Chase Brains
articles.brief: Chinese humanoid robot manufacturers have successfully developed advanced physical mobility and are now fiercely competing to build sophisticated artificial intelligence operating systems.

articles.headline: Elon Musk Admits Financial Hurdle for AI
articles.brief: Elon Musk highlighted severe financial pressures facing generative artificial intelligence enterprises, noting that staggering operational expenses are crippling startup profitability.

articles.headline: Republicans Scramble Ahead of Midterms
articles.brief: US Republican strategists are urgently working to counter a surging Democratic momentum ahead of the midterm elections, fueled by record early voting figures nationwide.

articles.headline: Michigan Senate Primary Rival Crosses Party Lines
articles.brief: In a stunning political shift, a prominent Michigan Democrat has endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers following deep internal party fractures and primary bitter feuds.

articles.headline: Kimi Antonelli Secures Historic F1 Title
articles.brief: Twenty-year-old racing driver Kimi Antonelli has claimed a historic Formula 1 world championship title following a stellar performance at the Mexico City Grand Prix.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi Lifts Inter Miami to Second
articles.brief: Lionel Messi delivered a masterclass performance, scoring a brilliant individual goal to secure victory for Inter Miami over the New England Revolution in MLS action.

articles.headline: India Likely to Meet FY27 Fiscal Deficit
articles.brief: Goldman Sachs reports that India is well-positioned to achieve its fiscal deficit target for the 2027 financial year despite lingering government spending pressures.
